name: Falcon 1 | RazakSAT
desc: RazakSAT is a Malaysian Earth observation satellite carrying a high-resolution camera. It was the first and only operational satellite to be put in orbit by SpaceX's Falcon 1.
loc: Ronald Reagan Ballistic Missile Defense Test Site, Kwajalein Atoll, Marshall Islands

land.d: Booster was expended during its first flight.
